page.overview:
What is Russellville, Illinois?

Russellville, Illinois is a small town located near the larger town of Haddonfield. For the longest time, the town was known for the murders of the Bowles family by Charlie Bowles.

In 2000, there was another murder spree that was said to be started by Ryan Nichols (it was actually Haddonfield murderer Michael Myers) involving the death of his wife, her family and Benjamin McNaughton.

Around the same time, three teens went missing and were assumed to be connected to the Nichols case.
